svg.text: A learned driver's lap of Spa-Francorchamps
PPO policy, deployed (mean action), one continuous lap from the start line — coloured by speed
The line is the path the car actually drove; colour is its speed. It stays near the middle of the road the whole way round and never leaves it.

[MEASURED] experiments/tracks_pilot/spa_curriculum.py, cross_track_penalty=2.0, 40M steps, checkpoint scored at its own speed cap 13.0 m/s · track [SOURCED] TUMFTM/racetrack-database (LGPL-3.0, OpenStreetMap ODbL) · double-track model, rung 2
